integrity: Scientific premises include the explicitly listed 120 vertices, the full 14400-element reflection symmetry group, and exact enumeration of all 280840 vertex triangles. The observed parity obstruction on orthogonal bases was known earlier and is expressly credited, not claimed as an independent discovery.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to all triples of the 120 vertices of the regular 600-cell at unit circumradius, not to arbitrary solid points or larger subsets. Group and orbit counts are certified by an exhaustive exact-arithmetic Python 3 checker; an unindexed older Coxeter orbit classification remains a historical-priority risk. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: Triangle metric orbits and the point-homogeneity degree of the regular 600-cell
